crossRefs.note: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.
Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it…
Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the…
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,
translations.bsb: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,
translations.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
translations.asv: Now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized, that, Jesus also having been baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
